title: Claw Finger
subtitle: #930-001 · revised render of 930-001_ClawFinger.scad (designed, no reference mesh) · feature names

labels.text: H1 hub R9, 10 thick (y -3.5 .. 6.5), round off its teeth, its rear face flush with the blade's, on which the finger prints
G1 hub teeth, 16-tooth pitch, module 1.25: they turn the follower finger
X1 hex bore, 10 across flats grown by slip: the box end over the Claw Axle's seat
M1 set-screw hole, Ø2.6 tapped M3, along 120°: blind, stopped 8.5 from the pivot under the blade
M1's one mouth, on the hub's far side at 300°: the screw goes in and comes out here, on the bench
B1 shank, 7 thick, 7 wide, its centreline 3.97 inward of the pivot, leaned 8.8° outward; its edges filleted R1
B1's root, filleted R2 onto the hub: the fillet ends at 140.625°, where the follower's teeth end
B1 arc: the legacy finger's curve, grip face R20.277 over 66.4°
T1 tip round R3.5: on the roll axis when the claw is closed

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. Its dimensions are claw_params.scad's and its features 930-001_ClawFinger.scad's header's. This is the drive finger; the follower's (#930-007) is drawn by the same file, mirrored, its hub's teeth moved half a pitch (claw_params.scad, THE MIRROR). Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
